about_the_game:
Explore an interconnected open-world adventure reminiscent of the very first Zelda title.

In Aurule Dynasty Demo you'll be able to explore the western half of the Kingdom of Aurule, which includes: a desert area, the mountains, the lake and a grassy area, and finally the dead woods to the south.

In the full game you'll have access to the indoor locations, the Eastern half of Aurule, including the Golden Realm, as well as the lands beyond Aurule!!

Also included in the Demo are the three indoor locations of an ancient Desert Spider Temple, the Shadowy Runaru Fortress, as well as the ruins of Redall Castle. These areas represent the dungeons that you'll find in the full game.

As you play the Demo you'll be able to fight some of the creatures and people living in the Kingdom of Aurule, as well as collect new equipment and inventory items. Some of the equipment has unique abilities.

This Demo will be exclusively in English, compared to the full game.
